evidence.reason: The array branch at line 32 returns at line 69 before the prototype check at lines 71-72. Reflect.ownKeys only sees own keys, so an inherited `toJSON` on an Array subclass (e.g. `class A extends Array { toJSON() { return []; } }`) is not rejected; `JSON.stringify(new A(1, 2))` invokes that hook and writes `[]`, while the validator accepts the value. This is a silent lossiness defect in the function's intended behavior.
